# The game timer during the original's opening: ticks per 70.086 Hz frame (0, 1, 2), from the frame after
# the tick at which the opening's first tune (2Fh) was started, to the frame of the last cel of OPENING9.
# Where the original's timer interrupts were held up (the PAN player reading its files, the Roland driver
# starting a sample) the music and the animation were slowed down together; following this track the
# emulated timer delivers its ticks as the original's did. Derived by tools/intro/opening_timer.py from the
# shared-clock capture of the original (DOSBox-X, 13 364 MPU bytes, 1 171 PAN frames, 32 sample starts, one
# clock); 7 258 ticks over 9 104 frames.
